crossRefs.note: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew…

parallels.note: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew…

translations.web: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
translations.bsb: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.
translations.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
translations.asv: And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
